title: AMO Cartagena Atlas — pin verification verdicts
method: One adversarial agent per place: OSM authority fetch (node/way/full), polygon centroid, street-geometry + house-number interpolation cross-checks, neighbor-venue consistency.

verdicts.reasoning: OSM node 14123990962 (fetched live, v1, 2026-08-26) returns lat 10.4235694, lon -75.5494741 — identical to the atlas record (0.00 m apart) — with tags name="El Pasquín de Joaco", amenity=restaurant, addr:street="130001, Calle Portocarrero #34-09, Cartagena de Indias, Bolívar", website=elpasquindejoaco.com, matching both records' name and address exactly. Haversine distance partner (Google Places) vs atlas/OSM = 13.23 m, well within the 25 m agreement threshold — a normal Google-vs-OSM building-footprint offset, not a conflict. Addresses are string-identical (Calle Portocarrero #34-09). Per rule, both_agree ships the already-live partner coordinate (10.4234706, -75.5495415).

OSM node 7074068385 (fetched live) returns lat 10.4251628, lon -75.5496562 — identical to the atlas coords (0.00 m delta), with tags amenity=restaurant, cuisine=seafood, name="Buena Vida", check_date=2025-10-23 (recently surveyed, v4). The cuisine=seafood tag positively matches the partner name "Buena Vida Marisquería", ruling out a same-name venue collision. Partner (Google Places) coord is 7.69 m from the OSM/atlas point — same building, well within the 25 m both_agree threshold. Addresses are consistent (atlas "Historic center" vs partner generic "Cartagena de Indias"; no conflicting street numbers). Canonical = partner coord (already live in production).

OSM way 49666923 (v7, 2025-10-24) is tagged name="Catedral de Santa Catalina de Alejandría", amenity=place_of_worship, denomination=roman_catholic, basilica=minor, wikidata=Q5047033 — exact name match to both atlas and partner records, confirming all sources point at the same building. Polygon centroid of the way = 10.4236628, -75.5507142. Distances: atlas↔OSM 0.55 m, atlas↔partner 4.34 m, partner↔OSM 4.89 m — all within the 25 m both_agree threshold; the partner/Google pin sits a few meters inside the same footprint. Partner address "Centro Histórico, Cartagena" matches atlas area with no street-number conflict. Canonical = partner coord (already live in production).

OSM way 955128419 confirmed as the monument (tags: name=Puerta del Reloj, tourism=attraction, building=yes, wikipedia=es:Torre del Reloj (Cartagena de Indias), wikidata=Q30594363). Polygon centroid of its 15 nodes = 10.4230343, -75.5491800. Haversine distances: atlas vs partner 6.4 m, atlas vs OSM centroid 4.3 m, partner vs OSM centroid 7.5 m — all within the 25 m agreement threshold, and both candidate coords lie inside the OSM building footprint. Addresses agree ("Plaza de los Coches gateway" vs "Plaza de los Coches, Centro Histórico"; the tower IS the plaza's gateway). Per rule, both_agree ships the already-live partner coordinate as canonical.

OSM way 955128421 fetched live: 19-node closed building tagged name='Iglesia de San Pedro Claver', amenity=place_of_worship, denomination=catholic, wikidata=Q9007271 — confirms the atlas source is the correct church. Polygon centroid = 10.4217758, -75.5512125. Distances: atlas↔OSM centroid 0.8 m (atlas IS the building centroid), partner↔OSM centroid 21.1 m, atlas↔partner 21.8 m. Both the atlas and partner coords pass a point-in-polygon test against the church footprint (building spans lng -75.55147 to -75.55095, ~57 m wide); the partner/Google pin sits at the eastern edge of the footprint facing Plaza San Pedro Claver, matching its address 'Plaza San Pedro Claver, Centro Histórico' — a typical Google Places entrance-side placement, not an error. All deltas are within the ~25 m both_agree threshold, so ship the live partner coordinate as canonical.

Partner record is null, so this needs a new record. Verified atlas coord against OSM way 93829748: the way is the correct feature (tags name="Centro de Convenciones Cartagena de Indias Julio César Turbay Ayala" — exact match to atlas address; addr:street="Calle del Arsenal", addr:city="Cartagena de Indias", amenity=arts_centre, building=yes; Calle del Arsenal is the Getsemaní waterfront, matching atlas area). The way is an 18-node closed building polygon; its area centroid is 10.420624, -75.549017, only 7.9 m from the atlas coord, and the atlas coord lies INSIDE the building footprint (point-in-polygon confirmed; footprint spans ~170 m, bbox lat 10.419826..10.421383, lng -75.549598..-75.548566). Atlas coord is authoritative-consistent; ship it as canonical.

Atlas and partner coords are 3.80 m apart (haversine), far inside the 25 m tolerance — same building. The atlas sourceUrl is a Google short link, not an OSM element, and an Overpass search for name~"Boh[eè]me" in Centro Histórico (bbox 10.418,-75.560,10.430,-75.544) returned no elements, so no OSM authority coord exists (null). Independent sanity checks: Nominatim reverse-geocode of the partner coord resolves to Calle Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria, Centro (colonial-name segment of Calle 35, matching address Cl. 35 #3-30); the coord is 32.33 m from OSM Plaza de Santo Domingo centroid (way 110342708, place=square, atlas coord 35.21 m) and 61.03 m from Iglesia de Santo Domingo (node 838199148) — consistent with a venue on the plaza-adjacent block per the atlas address "Plaza Santo Domingo". Canonical = partner coord (already live, shared by sub-venues ptr_CB_003, ptr_CB_005, ptr_R051).

OSM node 9977376517 (name=El Beso, amenity=restaurant, addr Carrera 10c #25-2, v2 2025-04-07) matches the atlas coords exactly (0.0 m), but sits 174.6 m from the partner coord — a genuine conflict. Street-geometry check settles it: OSM way 49458260 'Carrera 10' has alt_name 'Calle de San Antonio', the street named in BOTH the atlas and partner addresses (Cra. 10 #25-37, Calle San Antonio). The partner point lies 5.4 m from that way; the atlas/OSM point lies 162.8 m from it, instead sitting 1.5 m off 'Calle de las Palmas' (Nominatim resolves it to Calle Lomba) — its own tags (Carrera 10c #25-2) contradict the atlas record's stated address. Neighbor cross-check: Cafe San Antonio at Cra. 10 #25-99 (10.4199671,-75.5460989) is 60.9 m from the partner point on the same street, consistent with sequential numbering #25-37 -> #25-99; the atlas point is 171.9 m from it and not on that street. The atlas record is internally inconsistent (address vs coordinate); the OSM node appears misplaced or refers to a stale location. Ship the partner/Google coordinate.

Atlas and partner coords are bit-identical (0.00 m apart). sourceUrl is the hotel website, not an OSM element, and Overpass finds no 'Casa Carolina' mapped in Centro Histórico, so no OSM authority coord exists (null). Adversarial cross-check via OSM: Nominatim reverse-geocode of the pin returns 'Calle del Arzobispado, Centro, Cartagena de Indias' — the exact street in both records. House-number geometry on the same street confirms the building: OSM has Barbier at #34-74 (10.4240696,-75.5503704, 50.9 m from pin) and Época café at #34-52 (10.4238015,-75.5503310, 21.1 m from pin); Colombian plates are meters from the cross-street, and calibrating the corner from Barbier (corner ≈ lat 10.42340, matching the '5-08/5-10' addressed corner nodes on Calle de Manuel Román y Picón) predicts #34-14 at lat ≈ 10.42353, ~10 m from the pin — well within same-building tolerance. Neighboring OSM hotel node 'Casa Pombo' sits 11.0 m away on the same block, consistent with adjacent colonial properties. Partner address matches atlas address modulo casing. Caveat: the identical 7-decimal coords suggest both sources derive from the same Google Places record, but the independent OSM street/plate evidence corroborates it, so confidence is high. Canonical = live partner coord (10.4236246, -75.5502602).
